teams.description.help.text: Optional, for example U10. It is only a label.

teams.empty.text: There are no teams you can see yet.

teams.roster.no_candidates.text: Every player and parent of the group is already on this team. Give members the player or parent role to add them.

teams.archive_confirm.text: Archive this team? It stays available under archived teams.

teams.error.invalid_name.text: Enter a team name up to 64 characters.

teams.error.invalid_birth_years.text: Enter birth years between 1900 and 2200, the first not after the second.

teams.error.invalid_description.text: Enter a description up to 255 characters.

teams.error.roster_role_missing.text: Give the member the player or parent role first.

teams.error.roster_entry_not_found.text: That member is no longer on this team.

teams.slug_help.text: Used in the team's links. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; changing it changes the team's web address.

teams.error.invalid_slug.text: Use lowercase letters, digits, and single hyphens, up to 64 characters. Numbers alone and words like "new" or "edit" are not allowed.

teams.error.slug_taken.text: Another team in this group already uses that link name.

teams.children.help.text: Add a child who has no login. You answer for them, and they join this team as a player. Only you, the coaches and the managers see the name and birth year.

teams.children.prompt.text: You joined as a parent. Add your child to the team now.

teams.children.leave_confirm.text: Remove this child from the team?

teams.children.added.text: Your child was added to the team.

teams.children.joined.text: Your child was added to this team.

teams.children.left.text: Your child was removed from this team.
